info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Amazon API Gateway 2014 11 13 URL Scanner API
APIs.io Engineering Platform Search URL scans

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account Id

params.name: scanId
params.description: Scan uuid

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of objects in the response.

params.name: next_cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor to get the next set of results.

params.name: date_start
params.description: Filter scans requested after date (inclusive).

params.name: date_end
params.description: Filter scans requested before date (inclusive).

params.name: url
params.description: Filter scans by URL of _any_ request made by the webpage

params.name: hostname
params.description: Filter scans by hostname of _any_ request made by the webpage.

params.name: path
params.description: Filter scans by url path of _any_ request made by the webpage.

params.name: ip
params.description: Filter scans by IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) of _any_ request made by the webpage.

params.name: asn
params.description: Filter scans by Autonomous System Number (ASN) of _any_ request made by the webpage.

params.name: hash
params.description: Filter scans by hash of any html/js/css request made by the webpage.

params.name: page_url
params.description: Filter scans by submitted or scanned URL

params.name: page_hostname
params.description: Filter scans by main page hostname (domain of effective URL).

params.name: page_path
params.description: Filter scans by exact match of effective URL path (also supports suffix search).

params.name: page_asn
params.description: Filter scans by main page Autonomous System Number (ASN).

params.name: page_ip
params.description: Filter scans by  main page IP address (IPv4 or IPv6).

params.name: account_scans
params.description: Return only scans created by account.

params.name: is_malicious
params.description: Filter scans by malicious verdict.

items.docs:
Search scans by date and webpages' requests, including full URL (after redirects), hostname, and path.
A successful scan will appear in search results a few minutes after finishing but may take much longer if the system in under load. By default, only successfully completed scans will appear in search results, unless searching by `scanId`. Please take into account that older scans may be removed from the search index at an unspecified time.
